summary:
Our project focuses on the prevention and early detections of forest fires.

The application uses MODIS and VIIRS observations from NASA FIRMS on an interactive map. Users can select a date range and acquisition-time window to explore satellite detections. Each observation includes available information such as its sensor, acquisition date, location and Fire Radiative Power (FRP).
details:
Our project focuses on the prevention and early detections of forest fires.

The application uses MODIS and VIIRS observations from NASA FIRMS on an interactive map. Users can select a date range and acquisition-time window to explore satellite detections. Each observation includes available information such as its sensor, acquisition date, location and Fire Radiative Power (FRP).


Tools and technologies: Python, Flask, Pandas, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Leaflet.js, NASA FIRMS, Open-Meteo, OpenStreetMap/Overpass API, WorldPop and OSRM.
